comments.content: Using a default-constructed `Field{}` (Null) as both the left and right bounds when calling `getMonotonicityForRange` is fragile. Many monotonic functions branch on the actual range values to decide monotonicity/direction, and passing Null may not reflect "always monotonic" behavior correctly. For functions where monotonicity depends on the argument range (e.g. sign-flipping), `is_always_monotonic` computed against a Null/empty range may be misleading. Consider computing monotonicity over the full type range or documenting why the empty range is safe here.
